before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: Losing the enable in S_RUN is handled like an overcurrent trip and sent through S_HICCUP, as if a disable under load had to cool down before turning off
proposal.reason: Turning the converter off (en_SW or spi_enable low) while in S_RUN now registers S_HICCUP for one clock before S_OFF: hiccup_active pulses high and state_out shows S_HICCUP, which the strike counter and hiccup timer see as a hiccup entry.

before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: During soft start the latch read-back latch_state is treated as an overvoltage overshoot of the ramp, a recoverable event sent to the S_HICCUP cool-down, instead of a hard fault forcing S_OFF
proposal.reason: If latch_state rises while the FSM is in S_SS, the FSM goes to S_HICCUP for one clock (hiccup_active high, state_out = S_HICCUP, counted as a strike) before S_HICCUP's hard-fault test sends it to S_OFF, instead of going directly to S_OFF.

proposal.description: The gate drive in S_SS is decoded as 'ramp still in progress', so it drops on the clock the ramp reports SS_done, before the FSM has registered S_RUN
proposal.reason: At the end of every soft start, on the one clock where state is still S_SS and soft_start has already raised SS_done, en goes low for one clock before S_RUN turns it back on. The output therefore has a one-clock gate-drive dropout on every hand-over from soft start to regulation.
